Ugin's Mastery/manifested-creature-card-: With {1}{G} available and priority, a manifested Grizzly Bears is a creature card and must have a turn-face-up special action (CR 708.6). Observed: no turn_face_up option. This is the AGENTS.md cloak1 known approximation (turn-face-up for manifested and cloaked cards remains unimplemented); its existing P1 Morph/Megamorph/Disguise shared-path ticket owns the fix.
Strongbox Raider/attacked-exiles-two-and: The controller chooses one of the two exiled cards and may play it until the end of their next turn. Expected: the chosen exiled Lightning Bolt is castable from exile for {R} in the same main phase. Observed: both cards are exiled and the choice is posed and answered, but no cast of the chosen card is offered (priority offers only pass/concede with {R} in the pool). Kellan, Planar Trailblazer's 'exile the top card, you may play it this turn' passes, so the gap is this choose-one-then-may-play shape. Found by the FDN audit batch 4; no ticket yet.
Strongbox Raider/unchosen-card-is-not-pl: Expected the chosen Lightning Bolt to be offered and the unchosen Shock not. Observed: neither is offered (the Shock half holds). Same root as attacked-exiles-two-and-the-chosen-card-is-castable: the may-play permission for the chosen card is never granted.
Strongbox Raider/chosen-land-can-be-play: Expected the chosen exiled Forest to be playable as the turn's land drop. Observed: play is not offered. Same root as attacked-exiles-two-and-the-chosen-card-is-castable.
Strongbox Raider/still-playable-through-: CR 611.2b: the chosen card is playable during the opponent's turn and on its controller's next turn. Observed: it is offered on neither. Same root as attacked-exiles-two-and-the-chosen-card-is-castable.
Strongbox Raider/exile-is-not-optional: CR 603.5: the raid enter ability has no 'may' on the exile, so its controller cannot decline it. Observed: the engine poses the trigger as optional (yes/no) and answering no leaves both cards in the library. Found by the FDN audit batch 4; no ticket yet.
Stromkirk Bloodthief/opponent-lost-life-: CR 120.3a/119.3: damage dealt to a player causes that player to lose that much life, so after Shock hits the opponent the end-step ability's 'if an opponent lost life this turn' is true and a +1/+1 counter goes on the Bloodthief. Observed: the ability does not trigger (no target ask, no counter). The controls pass: life lost to a lose-life spell (life-loss-effect-counts) and life paid for ward (paying-life-is-losing-life) both trigger it. The engine's life-lost-this-turn count sums only life-change events, and damage to a player is a separate event kind that lowers life without one (rules/stack_helpers.go LifeLostThisTurn). New root, found by the FDN audit batch 5; no ticket yet.
Stromkirk Bloodthief/combat-damage-is-li: CR 120.3a: 2 combat damage to the opponent is 2 life lost this turn. Observed: no trigger at the end step. Same root as opponent-lost-life-counter-on-a-vampire: damage-caused life loss is not counted as life lost this turn.
Stromkirk Bloodthief/counter-can-go-on-a: Expected the counter on the targeted Child of Night after Shock hit the opponent. Observed: no trigger. Same root as opponent-lost-life-counter-on-a-vampire: damage-caused life loss is not counted as life lost this turn.
Stromkirk Bloodthief/life-lost-then-rega: Expected a trigger after the opponent took 2 from Shock and then gained 7. Observed: no trigger. Same root as opponent-lost-life-counter-on-a-vampire: damage-caused life loss is not counted as life lost this turn.
